sites.name: Rainbow Beach
sites.note: Site guide lists NNE–ENE; flown from the sand blow in a northerly on 1 Nov 2026, so N is included here.
sites.tide_note: Some high tides leave no safe beach landing below launch.

sites.name: Teewah Beach
sites.tide_note: 4WD beach access: check tide before driving.

sites.name: Point Cartwright
sites.note: Full SCFF members only (no visiting or temporary members). Controlled airspace: a Tower Contact Officer must be in place and you must check in every flight.

sites.name: Moffat Beach
sites.note: Cliff launch above rocks with a road directly behind. Self-assessment and a supervised first flight are required; check in every flight.

sites.name: Kings Beach
sites.note: Low launch above rocks and surf; needs about 12 knots straight on. Check in every flight.
sites.tide_note: Do not fly at high tide: no contingency landing.

sites.name: Towers
sites.note: Tight, thermic launch and a tricky bombout with powerlines. Sensitive site: carpool from Hovards Rd. No top landing.

sites.name: Mt Tamborine
sites.note: CHGC members, or visitors accompanied by a CHGC member. PG2 pilots need full safety-officer supervision and may not fly 10am–3pm (Sept–March) unless supervised by a CFI or SSO. UHF radio mandatory. Little room for error between launch and landing.

sites.name: Beechmont
sites.note: CHGC members; visiting pilots need a site briefing from a CHGC safety officer or duty pilot first. UHF radio mandatory. The Big Shelf is the only official bombout.

sites.name: Hinchcliffe's
sites.note: CHGC members, or visitors accompanied by a CHGC member. PG2 pilots require direct supervision.

sites.name: Mt Barney
sites.height_note: terrain height at the plotted point; launch unconfirmed
sites.note: Area forecast only. Mt Barney is not a listed SAFA flying site: there is no recognised launch, site rules or landing area, and it is inside a national park. Launch direction is unknown, so wind direction is not scored. Do not treat a good score as clearance to fly.

sites.name: Killarney
sites.rating: N PG2 · SE PG3 · E/W PG4
sites.note: All launches and landings are on private land run by Wicked Wings: contact the club before visiting.

sites.name: Ma Ma Creek
sites.note: Military airspace limits on weekdays; contact Wicked Wings first.

sites.name: Stanwell Park
sites.note: Club membership needed (3-day membership available). Landing markers must be set out before anyone flies.

sites.name: Hill 60
sites.note: Some local residents want flying here stopped: keep well clear of houses and follow the site guide exactly. Mainly a hang gliding site. The afternoon NE sea breeze can reach 25 knots; talk to locals first.

sites.name: Mt Blackheath
sites.note: Site briefing from a BMHGC safety officer required. Powerful thermals; strong local effects.

sites.name: Merewether
sites.rating: S face PG2 · E face PG3 supervised

sites.name: North Brother
sites.note: Best early in the day before the sea breeze. Visitors fly with an MNCF member; briefing required.

sites.name: Crescent Head
sites.rating: S launch all levels · E launch experienced

sites.name: Mt Borah
sites.note: World-renowned XC site with flatlands in front. The road to the top closes when wet.

sites.name: Lake George
sites.note: Private land: check in with the QR codes at the top and bottom gates.
